nodes.name: GL Count
nodes.notes: One free count per domain with the titles, 400 ms apart (GetLeads tolerates about 3 calls a second; the one-off measured it). One call a second: run 26024 at 400 ms drew 429s on 697 of 2,011 domains even with three 5 s retries; the count endpoint tolerates about one a second sustained. A 429 is retried five times 20 s apart, then carried as an error on the domain and the row is left untouched.
